intro: Three places I would start comparing land, water evidence, and road access. Numbers show a search order, not a drilling score.

areas.name: Ocotillo Mesa / Gate 4
areas.summary: My first scouting stop north of Study Butte. Look for a larger tract with a straightforward road approach near the documented wells; the small listing is a price reference, not the full land-development opportunity.
areas.water_summary: Several drilling reports show 80–120 gallons/minute at 182–368 feet in 2007–2020. A 2026 report shows 30 gallons/minute at 402 feet. All are reported while jetting during drilling, with no sustained pump-test duration supplied.
areas.access_summary: Highway 118 approach via Ocotillo Mesa and Gate 4 roads. The Gate 4 listing advertises less than one mile from the highway; the final approach is a private road.
areas.caution: Results vary within this box: other records report only 2–8 gallons/minute. The Gate 4 example is about $5,914/acre, so this is the water-first search, not the cheapest acreage. No listed parcel has verified water from this screen.

listings.title: Gate 4 Road · 11.16 acres
listings.location_note: Approximate listing map point, not a surveyed boundary.
listings.access: Seller advertises less than one mile to Highway 118 and an easy road approach. Private caliche road is reported in the listing details.
listings.water_note: The seller's claim about a good well area is unverified. No on-parcel producing well is established by this research.
listings.availability_note: Advertised active when checked October 23, 2026. MLS 174613.

areas.name: Ghost Town / Long Draw
areas.summary: The location-led candidate for a home base and future land sales. Proximity to Ghost Town could appeal to visitors and buyers even before water is solved. Long Draw has an advertised 393-acre tract off FM 170; any tourism or resale upside remains a business hypothesis.
areas.water_summary: One utility well recorded 375 gallons/minute during a 36-hour pump test in 1999, at 1,160 feet deep. Its GWDB and SDR entries describe the same well. This is historical evidence of a large source in the district.
areas.access_summary: FM 170 is the paved approach; the example is accessed by Long Draw Road. Internal roads, entrances, and crossings need a site visit.
areas.caution: The existing utility well is not a supply offered with the land. Other nearby records document unsuitable water. The example costs $975,000 for land alone, leaving water development as an additional expense.

records.label: Second utility well · 1,151 ft · yield not supplied
Historical abandonment · water described as unsuitable for drinking
30 gpm reported · source notes some oil in water

listings.title: 26885 Long Draw Road · 393 acres
listings.location_note: Approximate listing point from LandSearch, not the boundaries of the 393 acres.
listings.access: Advertised north of FM 170 between Ghost Town and Lajitas, via Long Draw Road. Power easements are advertised; installed power is not established.
listings.water_note: No water source is established for this parcel. The nearby historical utility test does not transfer to this land.
listings.availability_note: Advertised active when checked October 23, 2026. MLS 163273.

areas.name: Ranch Road east / North Corazones
areas.summary: My lower-price comparison, east toward Terlingua Ranch Lodge. Look along the paved part of Ranch Road and nearby feeders, prioritizing a property with an existing well that can be tested.
areas.water_summary: Three 2020–2021 drilling reports show 65–100 gallons/minute at depths of 120, 300, and 435 feet. These are jetting observations with no sustained test duration supplied. The same broad area also contains explicit dry-hole records.
areas.access_summary: The 40-acre example advertises frontage on both sides of paved Terlingua Ranch Road. Properties farther along local feeder roads can have a very different approach.
areas.caution: Dry holes at 500 and 682 feet, plus a 1,005-foot plugged dry hole, make this a mixed search area. The listing is roughly 1.4–2.4 straight-line miles from the three highlighted positive reports; none proves water on that parcel.

listings.title: 907 Terlingua Ranch Road · 40 acres
listings.location_note: Approximate listing map point. This is east toward the lodge, not at the Highway 118 junction.
listings.access: Seller advertises paved county-road frontage, fiber, and electricity nearby.
listings.water_note: No producing well on the parcel has been verified. Nearby positive reports and dry holes are shown separately.
listings.availability_note: Advertised active when checked October 23, 2026. MLS 165058.
